i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load the handed-in goal and context (what you are resolving) and the starting questions, if any. Read the glossary and the topic's relevant code/docs. Record pass when loaded.
i0-context.finding: Code read: sampled_runtime.py, task_calibration.py, gold_cycle/runner.py, runtime_contracts.py. Gold cycle runner trains modules, backtests each, assembles manifest - but never calls SampledEvoRuntime.predict() in backtest mode. FinalOrderSampleSet contains only ordinal predictions, no accuracy metrics. Confirmed: sampled runtime emits NO per-event scores in current artifacts.

q1.title: Scope: design+build vs follow-up issue only?
q1.imperative: Code confirms sampled runtime emits NO per-event accuracy scores (only predictions). Issue says: if no, open a follow-up issue. Does the user want us to design+implement the scoring infrastructure in this issue, or just open a follow-up issue and close this one?
q1.finding: Option B: design + implement in this issue. Add sampled-runtime backtest step to gold cycle, compute per-event scores, route into task_calibration_diagnostics.

q2.title: Which tasks to score?
q2.imperative: The sampled runtime produces stage snapshots for quali, race_start, and race. Which tasks should get per-event sampled-runtime scores in task_calibration_diagnostics?
q2.finding: Score all three tasks: quali, race_start, race. Goal is system-level calibration picture, not just the final race output.

q3.title: Backtest mode for scoring?
q3.imperative: SampledEvoRuntime.predict() supports sampled_state, oracle_grid, oracle_lap_n, oracle_all_states. Which mode for the gold-cycle backtest scoring?
q3.finding: Run both sampled_state (real-world end-to-end) and oracle_all_states (phase isolation). Both are inference only - no retraining. Results stored separately so task_calibration_diagnostics can show both profiles.

q5.title: Placement in gold cycle?
q5.imperative: Where does the sampled-runtime backtest step sit in run_cycle? After manifest assembly, before or after calibration fit?
q5.finding: After manifest assembly (line ~184 in runner.py), before calibration fit. Sampled-runtime backtest needs the assembled manifest; calibration artifact is downstream of module reports which are independent.

q4.title: Score the ordering or the pairwise matrix?
q4.imperative: FinalOrderSampleSet gives both final_order_samples and pairwise_finish_probability_matrix. What is the preferred scoring target?
q4.finding: sampled_backtest.py already exists with backtest_sampled_runtime() and sampled_order_metrics(). It scores FinalOrderSampleSet.pairwise_finish_probability_matrix against actual race result for the race task. Stage snapshots carry pairwise_probability_matrix per stage (quali, race_start, race). For all-3-task scoring: race is already covered; quali and race_start need stage-snapshot scoring against their respective truth sources (session_classifications Q, race_start_order). Gold cycle runner never calls backtest_sampled_runtime - that wiring is the missing piece.

q6.title: Stage scoring: extend sampled_backtest.py or new function?
q6.imperative: sampled_order_metrics only scores race-stage output. Scoring quali and race_start stages needs StageSnapshot.pairwise_probability_matrix vs truth. Should we extend sampled_order_metrics/backtest_sampled_runtime to include stage scores, or add a separate stage_snapshot_metrics() helper?
q6.finding: Option A: extend sampled_backtest.py with stage_snapshot_metrics() and wire into backtest_sampled_runtime. All sampled-runtime scoring stays in sampled_backtest.py.

q7.title: Shape of sampled-runtime rows in task_calibration_diagnostics?
q7.imperative: The current task_calibration_diagnostics[task] has slice_metrics and task_calibration keys, both derived from module event_level_metrics rows. Should sampled-runtime scores appear as a parallel sampled_runtime key at the task level, or merged into slice_metrics with namespaced field names?
q7.finding: Option A: parallel sampled_runtime key at task level. task_calibration_diagnostics[task] = { slice_metrics: {...}, task_calibration: {...}, sampled_runtime: { sampled_state: {...}, oracle_all_states: {...} } }

consolidation.summary: Sampled runtime emits no per-event scores today - confirmed from code. Gold cycle assembles the manifest but never calls backtest_sampled_runtime(). Infrastructure already exists in sampled_backtest.py. Design: (1) extend sampled_backtest.py with stage_snapshot_metrics() to score all 3 tasks (quali/race_start/race) per event; (2) add gold-cycle runner step after manifest assembly calling backtest_sampled_runtime for sampled_state and oracle_all_states modes; (3) route results into task_calibration_diagnostics as parallel sampled_runtime key; (4) update schema doc and add tests.
